content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stock photos

Conventional platforms like Stripe and PayPal offer payment processing as a service. They handle transactions but retain ultimate control over your funds and account. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy provide hosted storefronts with integrated payments, but they depend on Stripe or PayPal for processing. Sovereign commerce infrastructure, by contrast, deploys base-layer tools you own. Cloudflare Pages hosts your storefront. Cloudflare Workers handle backend logic. Supabase stores orders. NOWPayments verifies crypto payments. No platform intermediates your transactions. You own the stack. No subscriptions. No access revocation. Full data ownership.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe and PayPal exclude countries based on regulatory, financial, or political criteria. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy inherit these restrictions because they rely on Stripe or PayPal. If Stripe does not operate in your country, neither do these platforms. Sovereign commerce infrastructure bypasses these restrictions by using open networks. Cloudflare, Supabase, and NOWPayments do not discriminate based on geography. Payments process on-chain via cryptocurrencies like BSC, Solana, or TRON. Transaction fees remain under $0.10. The architecture is permissionless. It operates anywhere the internet reaches.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe and PayPal process payments instantly but can hold funds for days or suspend accounts arbitrarily. Their fees range from 2.9% + $0.30 to 5% depending on the transaction. NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee for crypto transactions. Payments confirm on-chain within minutes. Sovereign stacks eliminate platform fees entirely. You pay only for the infrastructure you use. Cloudflare Pages and Workers are free. Supabase offers a generous free tier. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys this architecture in 48 hours, configured and tested. The total cost of ownership is lower than renting a platform indefinitely.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure gives you permanent ownership of your commerce stack.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Platforms like Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy automate product delivery but retain control over your storefront and data. If they shut down or change terms, your business is at risk. Sovereign infrastructure automates delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Orders store in Supabase. Backend logic executes in Cloudflare Workers. You own the code, data, and delivery mechanisms. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for email reliability. Everything deploys to your GitHub or Cloudflare account. You retain full ownership and control after handoff.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you operate in a country Stripe or PayPal excludes, conventional platforms are not an option. Workarounds like VPNs or proxy accounts violate terms of service and risk fund confiscation. Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative. It is more complex to deploy but offers complete ownership and control. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is ideal for creators selling stock photos, ebooks, or courses. It deploys in 48 hours, fully configured and tested. If you prioritize infrastructure sovereignty over convenience, this is the only architecture that delivers.

Test end-to-end before going live. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) handles all these steps for you, deployed in 48 hours.

Yes. Sovereign commerce infrastructure uses NOWPayments for crypto processing and Cloudflare or GitHub for hosting. This architecture bypasses PayPal and Stripe entirely.
What happens if NOWPayments suspends my account?
NOWPayments does not require KYC and has no account suspension policy. Payments verify on-chain. You retain full control over your funds.
How do I handle chargebacks with crypto payments?
Crypto transactions are irreversible. Once payment confirms on-chain, the buyer cannot reverse it. This eliminates chargeback risk entirely.
